{{< video videos/labels_and_callouts.mp4 >}}

Text annotations on the 2K39 ensemble: 2D titles, 3D callouts anchored at the helix and
     the C-terminal tail, and residue labels at three Cα atoms, all following the conformers as
     they play. ProteinMotion writes the text on stroke by stroke; here labels are cut in and
     out, since a write-on needs a `progress` property on text annotations.

After ProteinMotion's [`labels_and_callouts.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/labels_and_callouts.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/labels_and_callouts.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/labels_and_callouts.py"}
{{< include scripts/labels_and_callouts.py >}}
```
